faqs.question: Will my current employer find out?
faqs.answer: Not from us. Your profile is anonymous by default, and you can block your employer by name so they can’t see it at all. Your name and contact go to a team only when you release them.

faqs.question: Is it really free?
faqs.answer: Yes, always. Companies pay us when they hire.

faqs.question: What happens to my recording?
faqs.answer: It is made with your consent and goes to teams that ask for you, with your name hidden until you release it. We hold transcripts for a set period, then delete them. You can ask us to delete them sooner.

faqs.question: Do I keep my score if nobody hires me?
faqs.answer: Yes. The score and the reasons behind it are yours, whatever happens next.

faqs.question: What if no team asks for me?
faqs.answer: If your area isn’t one we cover yet, we tell you on day one instead of sitting on your CV.

faqs.question: Which roles do you cover?
faqs.answer: Mid-level and up, across engineering, data, infrastructure, finance, operations and leadership.

faqs.question: Can I pause while I think about an offer?
faqs.answer: Yes. One switch hides your profile, and you can turn it back on whenever you like.
